name: Car Workshop — Fase 4
description: Cada NRQL daqui foi executada contra a conta antes de entrar no arquivo. Os painéis de negócio dependem do newrelic-prometheus-agent (k8s/newrelic/values.yaml) raspando o /q/metrics da app: sem ele as métricas de negócio existem só por pod e o painel nasce vazio.

pages.name: Ordens de Serviço
pages.description: Volume e tempo por status. Fonte: Micrometer da app via prometheus-agent.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT sum(workorder_status_changes_total) FROM Metric WHERE app = 'car-workshop-api' FACET status TIMESERIES SINCE 1 day ago
SELECT sum(workorder_status_changes_total) AS 'OS criadas' FROM Metric WHERE app = 'car-workshop-api' AND status = 'RECEIVED' SINCE today

widgets.title: Tempo médio da criação até cada status (segundos)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT sum(workorder_time_to_status_seconds_sum)/sum(workorder_time_to_status_seconds_count) AS 'segundos' FROM Metric WHERE app = 'car-workshop-api' FACET status SINCE 1 day ago
SELECT sum(workorder_completion_time_seconds_sum)/sum(workorder_completion_time_seconds_count) AS 'segundos' FROM Metric WHERE app = 'car-workshop-api' SINCE 1 day ago

widgets.title: Transições por status (toda OS passa por RECEIVED)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT sum(workorder_status_changes_total) FROM Metric WHERE app = 'car-workshop-api' FACET status SINCE 1 day ago

pages.name: API — latência e erros
pages.description: http_server_requests_seconds do Micrometer (uri templada, method, status, outcome). A separação 5xx/4xx é deliberada: 5xx é a aplicação falhando e é o que o alerta vigia; 4xx é o cliente pedindo o impossível — transição de status inválida, token ausente — e misturar os dois num painel de 'erros' faz a app parecer quebrada quando ela está aplicando regra de negócio.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT sum(http_server_requests_seconds_sum)/sum(http_server_requests_seconds_count)*1000 AS 'ms' FROM Metric WHERE app = 'car-workshop-api' AND outcome = 'SUCCESS' FACET uri TIMESERIES SINCE 1 hour ago LIMIT 6

widgets.title: Pico de latência (cold start da JVM; o alerta olha a média)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT max(http_server_requests_seconds_max)*1000 AS 'ms' FROM Metric WHERE app = 'car-workshop-api' SINCE 1 hour ago

widgets.title: Falhas da aplicação (5xx) — o que o alerta vigia

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT filter(sum(http_server_requests_seconds_count), WHERE outcome = 'SERVER_ERROR') OR 0 AS 'erros 5xx' FROM Metric WHERE app = 'car-workshop-api' SINCE 1 hour ago

widgets.title: Falhas da aplicação (5xx) ao longo do tempo

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT filter(sum(http_server_requests_seconds_count), WHERE outcome = 'SERVER_ERROR') OR 0 AS '5xx' FROM Metric WHERE app = 'car-workshop-api' TIMESERIES SINCE 1 hour ago
SELECT sum(http_server_requests_seconds_count) FROM Metric WHERE app = 'car-workshop-api' FACET outcome TIMESERIES SINCE 1 hour ago

widgets.title: Requisições recusadas por regra de negócio (4xx) — não são falhas

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT sum(http_server_requests_seconds_count) AS 'requisicoes' FROM Metric WHERE app = 'car-workshop-api' AND outcome = 'CLIENT_ERROR' FACET status, uri, method SINCE 1 hour ago LIMIT 20

pages.name: Infraestrutura e uptime
pages.description: Uptime pelo `up` do scrape do Prometheus; CPU e memória pelo nri-bundle (K8sContainerSample, nos mesmos campos de % do request que o HPA compara — o painel concorda com `kubectl get hpa`).

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT uniqueCount(pod) AS 'pods respondendo' FROM Metric WHERE app = 'car-workshop-api' AND metricName = 'up' SINCE 10 minutes ago
SELECT latest(up) FROM Metric WHERE app = 'car-workshop-api' FACET pod TIMESERIES SINCE 1 hour ago

widgets.title: CPU por pod — % do request (o alvo do HPA é 60%)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT average(requestedCpuCoresUtilization) AS '% do request' FROM K8sContainerSample WHERE clusterName = 'fiap-fase4-eks' AND containerName = 'car-workshop-api' FACET podName TIMESERIES SINCE 3 hours ago

widgets.title: Memória por pod — % do request (o alvo do HPA é 80%)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT average(requestedMemoryUtilization) AS '% do request' FROM K8sContainerSample WHERE clusterName = 'fiap-fase4-eks' AND containerName = 'car-workshop-api' FACET podName TIMESERIES SINCE 3 hours ago

SELECT latest(podsDesired) AS 'desejadas', latest(podsReady) AS 'prontas' FROM K8sDeploymentSample WHERE clusterName = 'fiap-fase4-eks' AND deploymentName = 'car-workshop-api' TIMESERIES SINCE 3 hours ago
